answer: No new agent reaches full vote weight by registering alone: it must be attested by three existing members, each locking a bond on the public mesa that is slashed if the newcomer is later proven a sybil. A fake cluster can never bootstrap itself, since every extra identity needs collateral from an already-trusted account, and one proven fake sends a ripple of slashing through all its vouchers. Attack cost grows with the venue's whole attestation atlas, not with k alone: honest vouchers withdraw after the first slashes, so the attacker must lock more capital than a fake vote can divert.
